title: V8 coverage defense is isolation plus an mtime window, not cryptography — an in-window self-forged profile still defeats the require gate

backstop: 每轮独立暂存目录 + mtime 窗 + 一份窗外 profile 毒化整轮（coverage/untrusted 上链、basis 降 'none'）；walk 审计可见；漂移检测兜底归因。README Honest limits v0.22 条目明示『不是密码学』。
